summary: Customer wants to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration in a dairy whey stream ahead of a concentration stage, using laboratory results as reference, and wants a first measurement concept that also copes with the stream turning more turbid under some operating conditions.

facts_stated.text: The stream is a whey stream in a dairy process and is relatively clear before a concentration stage.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage

facts_stated.text: The purpose is to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results are to be used as the reference.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

facts_stated.text: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.

facts_stated.text: The customer wants a first measurement concept that handles the change from clear to more turbid.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept that handles this change rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear.

targets.purpose: track the protein concentration of the whey stream as it changes
targets.enquiry_quote: track protein concentration as the stream changes

process.enquiry_quote: Our dairy process includes a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage

process.value: stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions
process.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.

customer_premises.claim: A first measurement concept can be produced now, before the deciding facts (protein range, process conditions, required accuracy and response time) are known.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept

customer_premises.claim: A single concept can handle the change from a relatively clear stream to a more turbid one.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: handles this change rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear

customer_premises.claim: Laboratory results will serve as an adequate reference for the in-line measurement.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

unknowns: protein concentration range to be measured
process temperature and pressure at the measurement point
installation point and distance (flow cell / probe, optical path length)
range and nature of the turbidity change (scattering particles vs absorbing species)
interfering components in the whey (fat, lactose, other solids)
type and origin of the whey stream
reference laboratory method details and sampling frequency
whether the measurement must be in-line, on-line or at-line
